text:
Priya (AccentA Product Lead): Hey team — kicking off Accenta onboarding. Goal: align stakeholders, define success criteria, and lock a 30/60/90 timeline. Can each of you confirm owners/constraints?

Ava (CSM): Thanks Priya! From CS side, success criteria proposal: 1) API integration finished and validated, 2) 500 daily active queries in staging, 3) p95 embed latency < 80ms in staging, 4) baseline NPS > 30 post-training. OK to use these? :white_check_mark:

Diego (Onboarding PM): Draft timeline suggestion: Week 0 — kickoff + infra runbook; Week 1–2 — API integration + smoke tests; Week 3 — UAT + enablement; Week 4 — go/no-go and success handoff. If we need a faster ramp we can compress Weeks 1–2. Thoughts?

Sam (Solutions Eng): I'll own API integration and schema mapping. Office hours Tue/Thu 9–11am PT for troubleshooting. Need dataset samples and a staging endpoint by Monday to start mapping.

Jon (Account Exec): Heads up — customer mentioned renewal concerns if model quality lags more than 2 weeks after initial rollout. Prioritize early quality evals and communicate timetable. @Priya can you confirm the eval corpus and who reviews quality?

Priya (AccentA Product Lead): Confirmed — I uploaded the initial eval set to the shared drive: https://drive.example/acc-eval (internal link). We plan weekly quality checkpoints and will run baseline against the Redwood-verified model family. I'll own the evaluation sign-off with Sam.

Olivia (Support Bot): :robot_face: New doc created: "accenta-onboard-runbook-v1" by Priya — https://docs.example/accenta/runbook-v1

Ava (CSM): Risk note — internal SSO for staging might take ~2 weeks to configure (security approval pending). If SSO is delayed, plan B is token-based auth for early API tests. @Diego please add as a dependency/blocker.

Diego (Onboarding PM): Will do. I'll create a ticket, tag infra/security, and mark SSO as a blocker in the runbook. Also setting up a recurring 30-min check-in Fridays 11am PT — invite out in a few mins.

Sam (Solutions Eng): For enablement I propose a 60-min session: API flows, error modes, observability (Console dashboards + traces), and best practices for batching/caching. I'll prepare slides and a demo.

Priya (AccentA Product Lead): That works. Also want a concrete feedback capture plan: short in-app survey at week 2 + adoption call in week 3 to capture qualitative issues. @Ava can you own the survey and reporting?

Ava (CSM): Happy to own it. I'll draft a 5-question survey (CSAT + top pain points) and share by Wednesday for review.

Priya (AccentA Product Lead): Great — next actions: Sam shares slides by Wed, Ava shares survey draft by Wed, Diego creates the SSO ticket and sends calendar invites. I'll circulate the eval rubric and access details today. Thanks everyone :rocket:
